measurement_plan.scope: P0 frontend A/B only; no comparator or full-pipeline victory
measurement_plan.plan: Nine fixed cases; three independent processes per target; three warmups/arm/case; ten paired trials/run; xorshift/seeded counterbalanced arm order; one complete run_decision per timed call including tape reset; validate full output each call; timer and indirect-call overhead retained equally; external file IO and DLL loading excluded

sampling.confidence: 10000 paired-log hierarchical bootstrap draws, sampling process runs and pairs; fixed seed 8219 plus case index; 95% intervals plus approximate 99.72% Bonferroni simultaneous intervals across the 18 case/target family; only three process clusters, so exploratory local estimates, not M8 proof
